# Latest Bleckmann DC in Lutterworth celebrates going live

 23 July 2026 

Bleckmann, a specialist in supply chain management for fashion and lifestyle brands, is celebrating the go-live of its latest mega distribution centre (DC) in Lutterworth. In less than four months, the new warehouse has been fully prepared for operations. This clearly demonstrates Bleckmann’s speed and flexibility, which enable the company to scale up. 

The warehouse, located in the Midlands’ ‘Golden Triangle’, is suitable for categories such as beauty, hair care, sports and accessories, as well as fashion clothing.

The opening of the DC, which covers 761,932 square feet (70,786 square metres), marks a significant milestone for Bleckmann in the further expansion of its lifestyle logistics offering. With the successful go-live, a key milestone has been reached, and the company is ready to operate at full capacity.

# Translink Express appoints four senior leaders after 32% growth

Translink Express Logistics has made four senior leadership appointments and announced plans to transform its Narborough headquarters into a major indoor palletised freight sortation centre.

 R By Ryan Fowler Publisher 

 1st September 2026 3 min read 

Translink Express Logistics has appointed four senior leaders as the Leicestershire logistics firm prepares for further growth ahead of its 40th anniversary.

The business has promoted Lee Barrett to head of traffic, Dan Green to the newly created role of head of project management and Shanice Walsh to head of operations.

Ryan Wallis has also joined the company as head of warehousing.

The appointments follow growth of almost 32% over the past 2 years, driven by new customer wins and existing customers increasing their use of Translink Express Logistics services.

The new management team will take on greater responsibility for the day-to-day running of the business, allowing the directors to focus more heavily on long-term strategy.

## Savers to open new Northampton distribution centre

27th August 2026

Yasmeen Louis

Savers is to open a new distribution centre in Northampton in late 2026, as it invests in additional capacity to support the retailer’s growth.

The site will be managed by GXO, which has worked with Savers for more than 25 years, and is expected to create up to 275 local jobs.

The new facility will provide additional capacity and flexibility across the retailer’s distribution network as the retailer progresses with an ambitious store-opening programme over the next three years.

Savers’ existing distribution centre will remain operational and continue to support stores and customers.

“With an ambitious store opening programme over the next three years, it strengthens our network and gives us the additional capacity and flexibility we need for the future, helping us serve our stores and customers even more effectively.

results.author: Mike Macdonald
results.text:
VB Distribution Expands Ahead of UK’s Vape Duty Change - Tobacco Reporter

# VB Distribution Expands Ahead of UK’s Vape Duty Change

VB Distribution announced the opening of a new 100,000-square-foot business park in Lancashire, England, expanding its national warehousing network to 500,000 square feet and strengthening its customs bonded storage capacity ahead of the U.K.’s Vaping Products Duty, which takes effect on Oct. 1. The company said the HMRC-approved bonded warehouse will allow duty-suspended storage, helping retailers better manage inventory and cash flow as the new tax is implemented.

Company CEO Natalia Gosciniak said the investment positions VB Distribution to provide compliant stock and supply continuity, alleviating cost pressures faced by smaller distributors without bonded infrastructure. VB Distribution, which supplies more than 50,000 retail shelf placements across the U.K. and reports an annual turnover of £500 million, said the facility is fully operational and could create up to 1,000 jobs as part of its broader expansion strategy.
